# rules-firmware.md — arduino-rfid-scanner (Arduino C++, firmware)

Binding for every agent and human working in this repo. `rules-common.md` applies too; where they conflict, this file wins for this repo.

---

## 1. Stack

- Language / runtime: Arduino C++ (`.ino` sketch) on the Renesas RA4M1 core for Arduino UNO R4 WiFi (`README.md`; `#include "WiFiS3.h"` in `mis/mis.ino`)
- Framework: Arduino core + libraries MFRC522 (miguelbalboa/rfid), WiFiS3, SPI (`mis/mis.ino`, `README.md`). No versions pinned. SoftwareSerial / SIM900A is removed with the SMS code (decided 2026-10-16).
- Package manager: Arduino IDE Library Manager (no `library.properties` / `sketch.yaml`)
- Database: none on device; persistence is in mis-backend
- Commands: dev = Arduino IDE Upload + Serial Monitor @ 9600 · test = none (manual on hardware) · lint = none · build = Arduino IDE Verify for UNO R4 WiFi (`arduino-cli` not installed)

## 2. Layer Chain (build order)

The sketch is `mis/mis.ino` plus the gitignored `mis/arduino_secrets.h`; layers are sections of the sketch.

1. config
2. hardware-setup
3. connectivity
4. input-handling
5. api-client
6. notifications — **retired**: SMS is removed (decided 2026-10-16). Parent notification is now a backend push to mis-mobile. Do not add on-device notification code.
7. main-loop

| Layer | Folder | Naming | Base / Wiring | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| config | top of `mis/mis.ino` + `mis/arduino_secrets.h` | `#define UPPER_SNAKE` for pins and constants; `const char*` for strings | file-scope globals; secrets only from `arduino_secrets.h` | `#define SS_PIN 10` |
| hardware-setup | `setup()` | — | `Serial.begin`, `SPI.begin`, `rfid.PCD_Init`, `pinMode` | `mis/mis.ino` `setup()` |
| connectivity | free function called from `loop()` | `checkX()` camelCase | red/green LEDs show Wi-Fi state | `checkWiFi()` |
| input-handling | `loop()` / named helper | state as file-scope `bool` (`is`/`has` prefix for new ones, rules-common 6) | edge detection on `INPUT_PULLUP` button; MFRC522 `PICC_*` calls | button + card read in `loop()` |
| api-client | named function(s) called from `loop()` | verb-first camelCase | raw HTTP/1.1 over `WiFiClient` | `/api/scan` and `/api/rfid/scan` blocks |
| main-loop | `loop()` | — | Wi-Fi check → button → scan → mode branch → `PICC_HaltA()` | `mis/mis.ino` `loop()` |

## 3. Layer Rules

- **config** — every pin and endpoint constant is declared once at the top of the sketch; never repeat a literal. The `Host:` header uses the configured server host, not a literal IP (`mis/mis.ino` L152, L186 break this today).
- **hardware-setup** — all `pinMode` / `begin` calls live in `setup()`; `loop()` never re-initialises hardware (`mis/mis.ino` L79–109).
- **connectivity** — red LED = Wi-Fi down, green LED = Wi-Fi up; keep that mapping. Reconnect attempts are time-bounded (7 s) (`mis/mis.ino` L41–55, `README.md`).
- **input-handling** — the button is active LOW with `INPUT_PULLUP`; toggle only on the HIGH→LOW edge. The UID format is uppercase hex, two digits per byte, `:`-separated; the backend contract depends on it (`mis/mis.ino` L118–143).
- **api-client** — every request bounds its wait (5 s pattern) and always calls `client.stop()` (`mis/mis.ino` L159–170, L204). The request/timeout/read/stop logic lives in one helper instead of being duplicated per mode (rules-common 1: same logic in 2 places).
- **main-loop** — `loop()` returns early when no card is present and calls `rfid.PICC_HaltA()` after a processed card (`mis/mis.ino` L132–133, L211).
- **New hardware or features** — constants in config, init in `setup()`, logic in a named function called from `loop()` (follows `checkWiFi()`).

## 4. Data & Validation

- Where input is validated: nowhere on the device; mis-backend validates `rfid` (`mis/mis.ino` L147, L182).
- Where persistence happens: mis-backend only. The device keeps no data, and the mode resets to yellow OFF (assignment relay) on reboot (`mis/mis.ino` L32).
- Request contract — **frozen, both kept as-is** (decided 2026-10-16: endpoints and payloads unchanged; mis-backend rebuilds them identically to `enrollment/mis-be`):
  - Yellow LED ON = **attendance**: `POST /api/scan`, `Content-Type: application/json`, body `{"rfid":"<UID>"}`.
  - Yellow LED OFF = **card-assignment relay**: `POST /api/rfid/scan`, `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, body `rfid=<UID>`.
  - The two encodings are **not** unified. Plain HTTP to the backend on port 8000.
- Response shape: not parsed; the status line/body is only logged (§5 Logging).
- Pagination / unbounded queries: n/a

## 5. Cross-cutting

- Auth: none. Requests carry no token or device id (`mis/mis.ino` L151–157, L185–191). Scanner routes stay public for now; any device auth must be agreed with mis-backend in the same ticket (decided 2026-10-16).
- Authorisation / permissions: n/a
- Scoping / tenancy: n/a (single device)
- Logging (decided 2026-10-16; this is the firmware's interpretation of rules-common 14 and 15):
  - All Serial output goes through `LOG_*` macros that compile to nothing when `DEBUG_SERIAL` is `0`. No bare `Serial.print*` outside the macro definitions.
  - Log status and errors with context (which endpoint, mode, HTTP status line, Wi-Fi state), at the point the event is detected — e.g. connect failed, Wi-Fi lost, response received.
  - Never print secrets: no SSID password, no full secrets header values.
  - `loop()` is the event loop, so one log per event in it is allowed; do not log inside inner `for`/`while` iterations (byte loops, wait loops).
- Config / secrets: Wi-Fi SSID/password and server host/port live in gitignored `mis/arduino_secrets.h`; a committed `mis/arduino_secrets.h.example` lists every key with placeholder values (decided 2026-10-16). The Wi-Fi password already in git history is rotated.

## 6. Tests

- Framework: none (repo tree).
- Location & naming: n/a
- Required per change: manual on-device check. Verify in the Arduino IDE for UNO R4 WiFi, upload, scan a card in each mode, confirm Serial Monitor output (with `DEBUG_SERIAL` 1) and LED states. Record what was checked in the PR/commit.
- Fixtures / factories: n/a

## 7. Prohibitions

- Do not commit `mis/arduino_secrets.h`, Wi-Fi credentials, server IPs or tokens; do not add secrets to `mis.ino` (decided 2026-10-16).
- Do not change endpoint paths, content types, body field names or the UID string format without the matching mis-backend change in the same ticket (decided 2026-10-16; `rules-common.md`).
- Do not reintroduce SMS / SIM900A / AT-command code (decided 2026-10-16).
- Do not move or rename `mis/mis.ino` out of its same-named folder; the Arduino IDE requires it (framework default; commit `acef65a`).
- Do not add unbounded blocking waits in `loop()`; network waits are capped (`mis/mis.ino` L47, L161).
- No bare `Serial.print*` and no debug-only output outside `LOG_*` macros (§5).
- Do not use pins 3–10 for new peripherals without updating the README wiring table (`README.md`, `mis/mis.ino`).

## 8. Self-Audit Checklist

Run on every touched file before finishing.

- [ ] Sketch verifies (compiles) in the Arduino IDE for UNO R4 WiFi
- [ ] Builds with `DEBUG_SERIAL` 0 and 1; no Serial output outside `LOG_*`; no secret printed
- [ ] No new hardcoded secret, IP or credential; new secret keys added to `arduino_secrets.h.example`
- [ ] Every `client.connect` path has a timeout and `client.stop()`
- [ ] `loop()` still early-returns with no card and calls `PICC_HaltA()` after one
- [ ] LED semantics unchanged (red/green = Wi-Fi, yellow = mode: ON attendance, OFF assignment relay)
- [ ] Endpoint paths, content types and UID format unchanged (or mis-backend changed in the same ticket)
- [ ] README wiring/feature tables updated if pins or behaviour changed
- [ ] Both modes tested on hardware; Serial output reviewed
